summary_1line: Bound by a vow after Lakshmana interrupts his meeting with Death, Rama banishes him; Lakshmana meditates by the Sarayu and ascends to heaven.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana stands weeping before Rama in the royal assembly as Rama, head bowed in anguish, pronounces his banishment.
On the quiet bank of the Sarayu River, Lakshmana sits in deep meditation as gods and apsaras shower flowers from the sky.
Indra descends and bears the radiant Lakshmana upward toward the celestial realm while the gods welcome him.
